title: DRAFT-CORR@v1 draft-correspondence output (sprk_analysisaction.sprk_outputschemajson mirror)
description: Constrained-decoding contract for the draft-correspondence proving capability (FR-P3-02). Property declaration order (subject -> body -> recipients_suggestion -> cited_refs) is the streaming emission order. The drafted correspondence is a SessionOutput ledger entry rendered for review (ADR-040 render-follows-store); the companion email.draft typed tool (side_effect_class=communicate, confirmation-gated) materializes the user-approved draft as a Spaarke sprk_communication DRAFT record (Communication service; NOT Outlook; DRAFT-ONLY - send stays user-initiated).

subject.description: Concise, specific subject line for the correspondence.

body.description: Complete professional correspondence body (plain text): salutation, purposeful paragraphs grounded in the source documents, requested action, closing with '[Your name]' placeholder.

recipients_suggestion.description: Email addresses found in the source text that plausibly identify the intended recipient(s), best-guess first; empty when none are present. Never invented.

cited_refs.description: The source references the draft drew from (file names; session output references when the request names them). An uncited draft is invalid (ADR-039 grounded outputs).
